bootstrap.estimates: per-policy primary score and all pairwise mean score differences
bootstrap.inner: for each sampled family occurrence, sample three seed IDs with replacement
bootstrap.outer: sample six task/family clusters with replacement
bootstrap.pairing: use the same sampled family/seed indices for every policy

inference_scope: descriptive small-sample comparison on these two operators and one GPU/runtime cohort; no oracle regret, unseen-operator transfer, trained-RL or policy-superiority claim
partial_campaign: preserve all attempts; do not publish a complete-study aggregate when identities, source, hardware, or completion checks fail
point_estimate: arithmetic mean across seeds within each family, then equal-weight mean across six families
revision_reason: v1 exploration admission could shrink a query timeout below normal measurement cost and kill the worker before final confirmation; v1 was interrupted and preserved separately. Only query admission and its source/protocol binding change; tasks, seeds, policies, scoring and analysis are unchanged.
secondary_reporting: successful and failed episode counts by task and policy
conditional confirmed latency ratios, with denominators and no substitution for failed episodes
elapsed wall time including setup and teardown
exploration queries, failed queries, invalid edits and query safety-cap hits
unit: six public TEST task/shape families, each with three paired seeds and three policies
